newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia rubber ends down after Tokyo falls.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia rubber ends down after Tokyo falls.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices ended the week lower after a weak close in Tokyo prompted some selling among nearby months and sluggish demand interest.
Dealers said expectation that some producers may try to sell at lower levels in order to attract buyers.
But buyers do not want to commit themselves as uncertainty in overseas market limited export business, they said.
"The market was unsure. Some Chinese and few European buyers were checking on prices but there were no heavy buying," a dealer said.
December RSS Ones buyer ended one cent down at 319.50 cents ($1.26) a kg and December SMR 20 buyer eased two cents to 308.
Traders offered the SMR CV at 364 cents, SMR L at 344, SMR 5 at 320, SMR 10 at 309, SMR 20 at 308 and drum latex at 238.
The INRO five-day average was 244.39 Malaysian/Singapore cents per kg on Nov 21 from 244.30 on Nov 20. The daily indicator was 244.43 against 244.68.
